name: Australian Gothic
summary: Australian Gothic is an aesthetic, literature and art movement based upon the darker side of the Australian identity and history.
description:
Australian Gothic is an aesthetic, literature and art movement based upon the darker side of the Australian identity and history. Contemporary instances can be similar to Suburban Gothic and other Regional Gothic aesthetics, but older pieces tend to have a more distinct feel to them (as early colonised Australia was vastly different from the rest of the world).

In the article More than Something Weird: Teaching Australian Gothic in the classroom , Australian Gothic is introduced with the quote "[Australian Gothic] has established itself as an effective approach and developed some clear strategies for tackling some aspects of colonial legacy which are otherwise difficult to articulate. There is also within the Australian Gothic genre an opportunity to explore the dark side of the Australian experience." [ 1 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Distortion, isolation, history

visualDNA.colour: Natural and desert-like tones such as brown, grey and dull greens. Dark monotones such as black and dark blue.
